status: specified after the locked primary 13-story result but before computing this direct-extension outcome
purpose: extend the exact earlier eight-story individual analysis settings to all 13 eligible stories for direct numerical comparability
stories: the same 13 eligible intact narratives and 567 motion-quality-controlled scans used by the locked primary analysis

settings.feature_transform: one pooled-TR scaler and five-component PCA fitted to all 13 stories

inference.primary_unit: one mean effect per story after averaging participants and 17 ROIs
inference.tests: two-sided story-level t test, one-sided Wilcoxon test, and one-sided sign test

interpretation: This direct-comparability result cannot replace the locked rich-baseline, story-held-out-PCA, 10-TR-gap primary analysis. It will be reported regardless of outcome.
